samples.summary: The new `design-editor:build` prerequisite edges (entropy + design-sandbox) have no test pinning them; only self-consistent generic checks exist
samples.evidence: This delta exists to fix a concrete failure: an unbuilt `packages/design-editor/dist` made `verify:entropy` die with `Could not parse knip output as JSON` and made `design-sandbox:check`'s tsc fail. The fix is entirely lane-graph data (`needs: [... "design-editor:build"]` in verify-self.mjs, entropy at ~line 452 and design-sandbox:check at ~line 380). The only tests over that data are in scripts/test/verify-self-lanes.test.mjs, and both relevant ones are self-consistent rather than fact-pinning: "a selected lane never runs without its prerequisites" (line 211) only walks the `needs` a lane already declares, and "a design-editor change runs its check AND the knip gate" (line 165) asserts `design-editor:check`, `design-sandbox:check`, `verify:entropy` and `core:build` but never `design-editor:build`. So deleting `"design-editor:build"` from entropy's or design-sandbox's `needs` — the exact regression this PR repairs — keeps the whole suite green, and the failure returns as an opaque knip/JSON error. The file already demonstrates the fact-pinning style it omits here (line 123 explicitly asserts `core:build` is pulled in by entropy's needs; line 145 asserts the same for frontend), so a matching assertion is cheap and clearly in the file's remit.
searchedFor: grep verify:fast in scripts/ for a lane/script parity test

samples.summary: Nothing asserts that the newly-separated `design-editor:build` lane actually produces the artefact consumers resolve; the checks that would are lane-order-dependent side effects
samples.evidence: With the build split out of `design-editor:check`, the guarantee that `dist/plugin/index.js` exists before consumers typecheck is now purely a `needs` edge. The tests that would notice a missing/renamed artefact (`has every export target on disk`, line 100, and `emits every module the built plugin loads at runtime`, line 188, which asserts `dist/` exists at line 209) run only in `design-editor:check`, which now depends on the build lane — so they can only ever observe a dist someone else built, and they are green-by-construction in the intended order. No test asserts the coupling that this delta newly relies on: that `exports['.'].default` names a path the `build` script emits (e.g. compare the manifest target against `tsconfig.build.json`'s outDir/include). If the build output path and the exports map drift apart, consumers (design-sandbox tsc, knip loading its vite.config) fail with 'Cannot find module', while design-editor's own suite is unaffected until its dist is stale.

samples.summary: The 'claimed by four lanes' claim in the inert reason is not checked by any test; the existing guard only requires ≥1 claimant
samples.evidence: harness.config.json's designEditor reason now enumerates four claiming lanes (design-editor:build, design-editor:check, design-sandbox:check, verify:entropy). verify-self-lanes.test.mjs's "every inert tag in harness.config.json is claimed by a lane" (line 69) only asserts `laneTags.has(tag)`, i.e. at least one claimant, so the count in the prose can go stale (or a claimant can be dropped) with no lane failing. Prose-vs-data drift here is low impact but the file's own comment tells editors to 'check the claimants when editing this', which is precisely the kind of manual step a test could replace.

verdict.reason: The delta's substance is two `needs` edges: `verify:entropy` needs `design-editor:build` (scripts/verify-self.mjs:458-464) and `design-sandbox:check` needs it (scripts/verify-self.mjs:370). No test pins either. In scripts/test/verify-self-lanes.test.mjs the designEditor test (lines 165-196) asserts design-editor:check, design-sandbox:check, verify:entropy and core:build but never design-editor:build — and on that tag path the build lane is selected by its own tag (verify-self.mjs:328) anyway, so it could not pin the edge. The docsProse test (118-127), which is the case where entropy's edge is load-bearing, pins core:build and slides:build only. The exhaustive prerequisite test (211-233) walks each lane's *declared* needs, so deleting an edge shrinks its work rather than failing it. A repo-wide grep for the literal `design-editor:build` finds it only in verify-self.mjs, packages/design-editor/scripts/verify-consumer.mjs:171, docs, harness.config.json:48 and .agent-review — no test. No generic invariant substitutes: laneOrderViolations (scripts/changed-areas.mjs:623-637) and the runner guard (verify-self.mjs:644-649) only check edges point backwards at known lanes. And nothing makes the resulting failure legible: scripts/verify-entropy.mjs:302-326 still emits the opaque `Could not parse knip output as JSON`, and scripts/test/verify-entropy.test.mjs has no knip coverage at all. So the exact regression this change repairs can be reintroduced with the suite fully green — a real behavior change with no meaningful test, major under the missing-tests lane.
